items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: But well Charlie Parker, without much time put in listening to him, just mesmerized me.

ctx.x: And it just sort of went on from there. I really can’t remember what influenced me after the period where I first discovered those Nat Cole and Art Tatum and Nellie Lutcher records. There was a period like I guess from the time I was 12 or so to when I started playing that I don’t remember listening to any newer records. Around 14 I started getting interested in some of Gerry Mulligan’s work and Shorty Rogers’ Giants, And that’s when I started trying to write, when I was about 15 or 16. But that interested me.…
Well tell me what it is like to go out and start playing with — when you started playing with Nellie Lutcher, you were how old?
